reasoning_content: The mysql client's argument parsing failed when stdin was redirected — the error "mysql: [Warning]..." from earlier worked with `db` as the database name. This time I passed `db` after the heredoc... The actual problem is: `mysql -udb -pdb db db < /tmp/diag3.sql` — the first `db` is the database name (fine), the second `db` got interpreted as a file argument. I should use `mysql -udb -pdb db < /tmp/diag3.sql` (which worked earlier).

action.command:
cd /workspace
cat > /tmp/diag3.sql <<'SQL'
SELECT LEFT(data, 5000) FROM config WHERE name='core.extension';
SQL
runuser -u dev -- ddev exec mysql -udb -pdb db < /tmp/diag3.sql 2>/dev/null | sed 's/\\n/\n/g' | head -80

tool_call.name: terminal
